journey.name: on-chain send without channels shows the bitcoin connecting view
journey.description:
Verifies that an on-chain send started before the node runs, on a wallet with no Lightning channels, waits on the bitcoin variant of "Connecting to network": the bitcoin coin inside orange rings, the title with "Connecting" in orange, and the body "Please wait for Bitkit to connect to the bitcoin network (±10 seconds)." A wallet with channels, or a Lightning send, keeps the purple Spending variant.
The view shows only until the node runs (a few seconds), so open the send right after a cold launch and take a screenshot as soon as it appears.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with no Lightning channels and a Savings balance, and a valid regtest address to send to. Start with the app closed.

actions.action: Force-stop the app, then open "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" with it (Android: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" to.bitkit.dev)

Verify the Send sheet shows "Connecting to network" with "Connecting" in orange, the bitcoin coin inside orange rings, the text "Please wait for Bitkit to connect to the bitcoin network (±10 seconds)." and a spinner
Verify the view gives way to the Send amount screen once the node runs, with the amount 10 000
Close the Send sheet without continuing
